findings.message: deploy_release_run is called with no arguments, but plugins/tool/deploy-release/plugin.sh:21-35 requires $2 as state_file and returns rc=1 immediately when it is absent ("state_file argument required"), making every non-dry-run, non-skipped real deploy fail; the tests mask this by setting _ZBUILD_DEPLOY_RELEASE_LOADED=1 and providing a mock that ignores arguments, but the live plugin was not updated to remove its state_file dependency.

When deploy_release_run returns rc=1 because state_file is absent, the error handler writes disposition=unavailable ("retryable"), but the actual failure is a broken calling convention (structural, not transient); this would permanently mislead operators and the engine's retry policy into treating every deploy failure as a recoverable outage.

When ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR is unset, deploy_agent_run returns rc=1 without writing any result file, violating the ADR-054 contract that every terminal exit path writes a v2 envelope; the old code also had no result on this path but at least attempted a summary write via the conditional ${ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR:+...} form.
